Pots are ideal for private homes and places like offices, restaurants, receptions and wedding venues. Thanks to the availability of 6 sizes and 25 colours (shades of gold, silver, red, blue, grey, black, pink, purple, orange) our houseplant pots are perfect for planting large plants, decorating, re-potting and arranging multi-species plants. Small pots in the width of 4 inches, 5 inches and 6 inches are great for window sills, tables, shelves and kitchen herbs. Large ones 7 inches, 8 inches and 10 inches are ideal for eye-catching floor displays. Every pot has drainage holes and an integrated saucer attached to the bottom by pins. 6 small and large sizes to choose from: 12 cm, 14 cm, 16 cm, 18 cm, 21 cm and 26 cm ( 4.8 inches, 5.3 inches, 6 inches, 7 inches, 8 inches and 10inches)

summary.text: Customers find the planter looks expensive and appreciate its value for money. The pot is lightweight, sturdy, and bigger than expected, with one customer noting it suits their black, white, and gold bathroom beautifully. The drainage system receives mixed feedback - while one customer mentions it comes with drainage holes already made, another reports issues with the gold part wearing away. Customers disagree on the ease of removing the drainage saucer.

authors_reviews.title: Cheap and cheerful
authors_reviews.text: Really good viewed from a distance. Doesn't look at all 'plasticky' & at first glance looks far more expensive than it is. Close up, though, lots of places on drainage saucer where the gold part is worn away & the surface of the pot itself isn't totally perfect.Also as many others have said, it's very difficult to remove the drainage saucer. There are drainage holes, so provided you don't overwater -with or without an extra pot within - maybe there's no need to remove the drainage saucer?Overall, given the price, definitely worth considering.
authors_reviews.author: Gill

authors_reviews.title: Affordable, stylish, and practical
authors_reviews.text: Affordable, stylish, and practical. I love how this pot looks in my flat (it's not as shiny as the photos suggest), which is actually a plus. It also has drainage holes, which are essential for plant health. Overall, I’m really happy with this product.
